rows.grounds: numeral indicating a set of eight
fused form of siddhisaṃprāptiḥ and mūlakaulaṃ; attainment of powers identified as the root Kaula

items.question: What constitutes the root Kaula teaching addressed to the fair-faced goddess?
premises: Eight elements are enumerated in this context.
The attainment of powers is included.
This attainment is identified as the root Kaula.
items.inference: The root Kaula consists of the eight elements together with the attainment of powers.
uncertainties: The specific eight elements are not named in this verse and must be inferred from context.
The exact internal structure of the fused compound siddhisaṃprāptirmūlakaulaṃ allows alternative readings.
items.plain_english: And the eight, along with the attainment of powers, constitute the root Kaula, O fair-faced one.
